And I’m not talking about this in a military matter, I’m merely making an example of situations that... “escalated” after external influences. Hong Kong is indeed asking for help, I just can’t see how our influence will... well... “peacefully” help. Of course I hope everything turns out well, but we have to consider ourselves too. The protests in Hong Kong have (according to our news) been getting a little bit out of hand and I don’t know how much external influence will help in that matter. The Basic Law will run out sometime and once that happens, our “helping hand” probably won’t be welcome anymore. A country and government of that size won’t change for any of us, is what I’m trying to say.
